The actual test only exercises `data_samples` + `test_LocalDate_from_Symmetry454Date`. Everything else (the other `data_*` providers and ~40 imports) is dead code that obscures what the test does. I'll keep behavior identical while removing the noise and clarifying intent.Compiles cleanly (`COMPILE_OK`). I improved readability by removing ~40 unused imports and 12 dead data-provider methods that were never referenced by the single test, then reformatted `data_samples` one pair per line with each historical-event comment placed directly above its sample, and renamed parameters to `symmetry454Date`/`expectedIsoDate`. The same method (`LocalDate.from`) is still called with the same arguments and asserted against the same expected values.
